attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Hearing and Speech Examining Board (Department of Safety and Professional Services)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by AAA, ASHA, the Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction (DPI), the International Hearing Society (IHS) or NBC-HIS; graduate courses from an accredited university directly related to the profession; other courses only with Board pre-approval requested by the provider 30 days before the course.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued shortly before the deadline still renew by Jan 31 of the odd-numbered year.

topics.who: All SLPs and audiologists, at least 2 hours relating to ethics within the 20

rules.legal_basis: Wis. Admin. Code ch. HAS 8; Wis. Stat. ch. 459
rules.notes: Two-year reporting period Feb 1 of an odd-numbered year to Jan 31 of the next odd-numbered year (e.g. Feb 1, 2025 – Jan 31, 2027); renewal due Jan 31 of odd years. Same 20 hours incl. 2 ethics for SLPs and audiologists (per the DSPS profession pages). The admin-code site docs.legis.wisconsin.gov could not be opened from our location, so numbers come from the DSPS pages. Wisconsin does not license SLP assistants.
